data.body: rebar-debug final report — completion-validator close failure. Problem: the first normal close returned FAIL for 10 runtime/git/CI/external acceptance criteria even though the release receipts contained concrete command outputs, URLs, timestamps, commits, and hashes. Proven mechanism: the 10 criteria lacked the exact [operator-attested] prefix, so ADR 0043 and src/rebar/llm/reviewers/completion_verifier.md deliberately classified them as codebase-verifiable and refused comment-only evidence. Classification: intended validator behavior / ticket-contract mismatch, not a completion-validator code defect. Proof: the first finalizer named the missing tag for every failed criterion; all 10 exact lines returned no findings from operator_evidence_ac_gaps; after retagging only the criterion metadata, check-ac passed 31 criteria, plan review signed PASS at 364cb2327a, and the normal non-force close signed completion-verifier PASS at that SHA. The tagged FAIL-to-PASS experiment rejects the suspected recovery instruction-locality defect: after the primary run hit the runaway safeguard, bounded per-criterion recovery and the tool-free finalizer accepted the same receipts. Fix/test/safety: no production or test code changed; correcting the acceptance-evidence kinds was the appropriate non-code remediation, with no dependency, API, or behavioral impact. Replication: the original close scenario no longer reproduces and ticket 9874-b1a9-2ff1-4cd3 is durably closed with signed PASS. Residual prevention: detector/coaching gap is recorded on existing ticket deeb-89c1-1080-4690 and linked discovered_from this release. Recovery cost directly overlaps existing ticket 2948-48e5-666f-4677; however its implementation commit 556708771e is not reachable from release SHA 364cb2327a or current origin/main, and Gerrit 1463 remains NEW with Verified -1, so it was not shipped in 0.11.0.
